message: 新たなる敵

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, get back here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, stop! Don't chase after them!」
Although a few managed to get away, we somehow succeeded in driving them back.

name: Lolotte
message: 「What was that all about?! I can't believe there are Demons that strong, it's shocking!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think we'd actually get pushed that hard against them... Honestly, I'm kinda in shock.」
None of us wear the expressions of people who just won a battle.
Up until now, all we had to do was join forces and intercept whatever came lunging blindly at us.
However, this time was different.
Moving as an organized unit, capable of independent thought... We had fought Demons who knew the meaning of teamwork.
The magical power they wielded was also on a completely different level than anything before.
Just when we were finally getting used to our activities as Crusaders, not a trace of our previous easygoing mood remained.

name: Ria
message: 「It looks like things aren't going to be so straightforward after all.」
Ria-senpai muttered with a serious expression on her face.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you mean enemies even stronger than them might start showing up from now on?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... probably.」
Indifferent to our unease, a shooting star twinkles in the sky. Surely, not a single one of us notices it.

name: Synn
message: 「It's already late today, so let's think about it tomorrow. Does that sound okay?」
Everyone nodded quietly.
Every single one of our footsteps must have felt heavy on the walk home.
